lecture_notes: The lecture discusses the performance improvements of the GLM 5.3 model, emphasizing that these gains were achieved exclusively through post-training techniques rather than the development of a new base model. By applying post-training to the existing GLM 5.2 architecture, significant performance leaps were observed across various benchmarks, particularly in cybersecurity. The model achieved a score of 84.5 in cybersecurity benchmarks and 28.3 on Terminal Bench, a substantial increase from the 4.6 score achieved by its predecessor, GLM 5.2. These results demonstrate that post-training is a critical phase in the model development lifecycle, capable of elevating model performance to compete with frontier-level AI models.
